description: Cross-chain transfer volume from Wormholescan (Wormhole network): USD and token counts grouped by source to destination chain over the newest N transfers (1 to 100). A recent window, not total bridge TVL or long-term trends. Transfers with no USD price are counted but not summed. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_chain_tips when you need recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks; crypto_dydx_chain_markets when you need dYdX v4 perpetual market for one ticker: status, oracle. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many of the newest transfers to read, 1 to 100 (default 50)

name: crypto_cross_chain_bridge_flows
